# PlussTils API Reference

[Back to PlussTils](index.md)

PlussTils' reference material is organized by domain:

- [PlussView architecture](plussview_architecture.md): how the desktop viewer is put
  together.
- [PlussView window runtime](plussview_window_runtime.md): the runtime behavior of a
  live viewer window.
- [MATLAB-style popup viewer roadmap](matlab_popup_viewer_roadmap.md): planned work for
  a popup-viewer surface.

**Pathing** and **Aux** (including `pluss::OutputEngine`) are not documented here yet.
